newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kuroda Electric to set up Philippine venture.
newsitem.headline: Kuroda Electric to set up Philippine venture.

text.p: Kuroda Electric Co Ltd said on Monday that it and insulation maker Hoyo KK will jointly set up a firm in the Philippines in December to manufacture electrical appliances.
The joint venture, Kuroda Hoyo (Philippines) Inc, will be capitalised at about 200 million yen and equally held by Kuroda Electric's wholly owned subsidiary Z. Kuroda (Singapore) Pte Ltd and Hoyo.
The new firm is expected to post annual sales of 600 million yen in three years, Kuroda Electric said in a statement.
